mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_watch_prediction (analysis_id, symbol, market, stock_name, horizon_code, horizon_trading_days, forecast_date, source_price, direction, probability, target_low, target_high, expected_return_low, expected_return_high, invalidation_price, rationale, input_snapshot_json, status) VALUES (#{analysisId}, #{symbol}, #{market}, #{stockName}, #{horizonCode}, #{horizonTradingDays}, #{forecastDate}, #{sourcePrice}, #{direction}, #{probability}, #{targetLow}, #{targetHigh}, #{expectedReturnLow}, #{expectedReturnHigh}, #{invalidationPrice}, #{rationale}, #{inputSnapshotJson}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM stock_watch_prediction WHERE analysis_id = #{analysisId} ORDER BY horizon_trading_days ASC, id ASC
SELECT * FROM stock_watch_prediction WHERE status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY forecast_date ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE stock_watch_prediction SET status = #{status}, evaluated_trade_date = #{evaluatedTradeDate}, actual_close = #{actualClose}, actual_high = #{actualHigh}, actual_low = #{actualLow}, actual_return_pct = #{actualReturnPct}, direction_hit = #{directionHit}, range_close_hit = #{rangeCloseHit}, range_touch_hit = #{rangeTouchHit}, invalidated = #{invalidated}, absolute_error_pct = #{absoluteErrorPct}, brier_score = #{brierScore}, evaluation_note = #{evaluationNote}, evaluated_at = #{evaluatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
